en: I caught the cat at home.
I didn't catch the bus on time.
You got the job at the bank.
You didn't catch a taxi at night.
You held the door with your hand.
My brother held the glass with his hand.
He didn't hold the pen well.
Mom held her daughter's hand.
She didn't catch the train on time.

lat: sheddina bzzaf dyal l-7ut f l-b7er
en: We caught a lot of fish in the sea.
We didn't get the ticket for the match.
You caught the thieves in the street.
You didn't hold the rope well.
They caught the thief at the market.

lat: ma sheddush l-ktub dyalhum mn l-madrasa
ar: ما شدوش الكتب ديالهم من المدرسة
en: They didn't get their books from school.
I hold my daughter's hand in the street.
I don't catch fish with my hands.
You hold the book with your hand.

lat: ma katsheddsh l-7afila dima f l-wqt
en: You don't always catch the bus on time.
You hold your son's hand in town.
You don't hold on to your money well.

lat: kayshedd weldu mn yeddu f t-tariq
en: He holds his son by the hand on the road.
He doesn't hold the phone in his hand.
Mom holds the basket with her hand.
She doesn't always hold her cat.

lat: kansheddu t-tobis kul sba7 f l-m7etta
en: We catch the bus every morning at the station.

lat: ma kansheddush l-flus dyalna mn l-bank
ar: ما كنشدوش الفلوس ديالنا من البنك
en: We don't get our money from the bank.

lat: katsheddu t-tren dyal tmenya kul nhar
ar: كتشدو الطرن ديال تمنية كل نهار
en: You catch the eight o'clock train every day.
You don't catch the ball well.

lat: kaysheddu l-karr dyal l-madrasa kul sba7
ar: كيشدو الكار ديال المدرسة كل صباح
en: They catch the school bus every morning.
They don't catch the eight o'clock bus.
I'm going to catch the taxi from the station.

lat: ma ghadish nshedd had l-7aja b yeddi
ar: ما غاديش نشد هاد الحاجة بيدي
en: I'm not going to hold this thing with my hand.
You're going to hold the door until I come.
You're not going to hold the boy by yourself.
You're going to get the keys to the house.
You're not going to hold my bag.
He's going to hold the donkey with the rope.

ar: ما غاديش يشد الباب على خوه
en: He's not going to hold the door for his brother.

lat: ghadi tshedd yed bentha f l-madrasa
en: She's going to hold her daughter's hand at school.

lat: ma ghadish tshedd l-flus mn 3and khtha
ar: ما غاديش تشد الفلوس من عند ختها
en: She's not going to get the money from her sister.
We're going to catch the three o'clock train.

lat: ma ghadish nsheddu hadshi kamel b yeddina
ar: ما غاديش نشدو هادشي كامل بيدينا
en: We're not going to hold all this with our hands.
You're going to get a seat on the bus.

lat: ma ghadish tsheddu l-khobz bla flus
ar: ما غاديش تشدو الخبز بلا فلوس
en: You're not going to get the bread without money.

lat: ghadi ysheddu l-7ut f l-b7er ghedda
en: They're going to catch fish in the sea tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish ysheddu l-karta dyalhum ghedda
ar: ما غاديش يشدو الكارطة ديالهم غدا
en: They're not going to get their card tomorrow.
